hook_line: INDIA IN FINAL-STAGE TALKS ON EXPANDED BRAHMOS MISSILE SALE TO PHILIPPINES

hook_stat.sub: Missiles in about five BrahMos systems the Philippines is expected to buy

news_summary: India is in final-stage talks to expand its BrahMos missile sale to the Philippines, with Manila expected to buy about five systems — nearly 60 missiles worth $700 million to $800 million, three sources told Reuters.
payoff: A signed deal would be one of the largest single orders behind India's defence export growth.
